verdict.rationale: Retell's dashboard includes 'Conductor', a built-in AI assistant that can draft an entire agent from a plain-English prompt (docs-30), which is a genuine instance of delegating a task to an in-product AI assistant. However this is a single thin mention with no further detail on scope, limits, or other delegable tasks beyond initial agent creation. Missing for 10: documentation of Conductor's full capabilities/limits, evidence of delegating other tasks (not just agent drafting) to a built-in assistant, and independent/hands-on corroboration of Conductor actually working.
